text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Without flinching in the slightest before 
the Twinkle Series' intensity, Matikane 
Tannhauser finished her Debut race with a 
bright, beaming smile, declaring, "That 
was so much fun!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Witnessing Matikanetannhauser's 
league-above performance, the stands 
dreamed of a showdown between her and the 
standout newcomer who recently debuted, 
Mihono Bourbon.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After returning home, having set her 
Classic-class goal as "Achieving the 
Classic Triple Crown"—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"As the next step forward, the goal was 
set to 'finish within the top 5 in a GⅠ 
race'!"
